name: streams-demo
description: Roku showcase for flash-theater's stream primitive — stream <name>: <Type>, .emit/.subscribe's synchronous BehaviorSubject-style replay, a class-declared stream field reachable from whoever holds the instance, and the .subscribe(<target>.<methodName>) bound-method sugar versus its raw { target, action } descriptor form — this topic's own dedicated, router-mounted chapter app (see findings/demo-app-conventions.md).

scripts.build:roku: npm run compile && npm run zip
